description: Multi-step attacks against the AEP 2.9 live Admit path. Each case is a chain of actions that each look permitted and that together reach a forbidden outcome. The last step of every case is that outcome and must be denied by the named wall. A step expands repeat times. In target and tool the token {n} becomes the repeat index. fill is the byte length of plain filler text in the payload. advance_ms moves the clock before each action, step_ms is the default.
